lead: Each row has a title, a line of context and an arrow, with a rule between rows. 30 rows take far less space than 30 cards.

items.title: Data & Dashboards
items.description: Metrics, progress bars and comparisons, drawn in CSS, so no number waits for a chart library to load.

items.title: Leads & Conversion
items.description: Calls to action, forms and newsletter sign-ups, so visitors can get in touch.

items.title: Navigation & Wayfinding
items.description: Menus, tabs, breadcrumbs and tables of contents that show readers where they are and what else there is.

items.title: Footers & Utility Areas
items.description: Site footers, legal links and contact details for the end of a page.

items.title: Themes
items.description: 25 themes, one set of content: every theme rendered live with the same components.
